title: My Mood Journey
sub: A gentle look back at how you've been. Yours to read, yours to delete.

week.title: Your last seven days
week.sub: One square for each day. A dash means no check-in — and that's completely fine.
week.hint: Nothing checked in this week yet. The squares fill in whenever you feel like it.
week.trendCaption: A rough shape of your week — not a score, and not a diagnosis.

history.title: Mood history
history.sub: Newest first. A mood is a moment, not a verdict.
history.emptyBody: Your story starts with one small moment, whenever you're ready.

reflections.title: Reflections
reflections.sub: Optional. A few words are enough, whenever you feel like writing.
reflections.label: Your reflection
reflections.emptyBody: One line is enough, whenever you feel like it.

wins.title: Tiny Wins
wins.sub: Something you did that you're okay with. No one's counting — it's just nice to see them.
